title: Acceptance-evaluation fixtures bet a real 2 s wall-clock authority budget on a synchronous SQLite persist, so the full gate fails intermittently on master d705038
outcome: The acknowledge_fixture_work fixture and any other test that drives named-root authority acknowledgement no longer depend on wall-clock time to succeed. They use a scripted clock or a test path whose budget does not include its own synchronous persist. The full gate therefore can't fail on that budget under load, and a witness that stalls the persist past the budget fails before the fix and passes after it. The timeout is not increased.
acceptance: Deterministic witnesses preserve the prior budget failure and show that manual persistence, delta/lock waits and worker scheduling do not consume a positive fixture's scripted authority budget; the affected acceptance-evaluation and turn-observation fixtures pass on the corrected input.

One explicit state-scoped monotonic clock governs fixture authority/admission deadlines through prepare, canonical read, durable acknowledgement, publication, remaining RPC checks and boot coordinator/workers; scripted advancement exercises expiry and clock-aware waits. Actual persistence and owner checks remain real. Production and explicit real/default/connected deadline coverage retain one end-to-end budget, late-commit withholding and existing timeout values; no timeout is enlarged.
The maintained full five-stage gate passes on the exact final input, and independent read-only Codex and Claude reviews leave no outstanding in-scope Medium or higher finding.
